glossary_subset.notes: Mascaras amaldicoadas que concedem poder; 'Akuruka do Raio' e de Mikazuchi. Lore central do arco.

Ave Hororon gigante; montaria/pet da Rulutieh.
(cap.22) O mundo e a Terra num futuro distante (reveal sci-fi). 'Earth' -> 'Terra'.
Nome dado ao protagonista por Kuon em 11_02 (0x12668). reveal_timing: cena 11_02. Antes disso ele é sem nome.
(cap.20) Espadachim 'a Lamina Miragem'; pai adotivo de Shinonon; lado Uzurusha. MASCULINO. manter nome; traduzir epiteto. Fonte: wiki.
(cap.23) Braco-direito de Benawi, general de Tuskur. MASCULINO. Nome proprio - manter. Fonte: wiki (utawarerumono.fandom/Kurou).
Rótulo de falante (memória); identidade não revelada — genérico.
(cap.22) Nacao-refugio fundada por Hakuowlo; terra natal de Kuon (princesa de Tuskur). Tambem nome da velha boticaria homonima. manter. Fonte: wiki.
(cap.23) Patente militar (Warmaster of Tuskur, de Benawi). Traduzir -> 'Mestre de Guerra'. Fonte: wiki.
(cap.20) Gentilico de Yamato (ja coberto). 'Yamatan army' -> 'exercito de Yamato'; 'yamato' invariavel. Forma derivada, nao entidade nova.
Nacao/estado onde se passa o cap.12; composta de muitas provincias; capital = sede do Mikado. Manter.

lines: Características: acolhe sem pressionar ("Apenas relaxe..."); curiosa mas paciente; calor humano.
Red flags: soar fria, clínica ou impaciente; formalidade excessiva.
Haku (protagonista, narração 1ª pessoa) — `voice_criticality: high`. Predomina nas 2 cenas:
Características: sentenças curtas e definitivas; duplo sentido ("um mundo totalmente novo te espera"); ambiguidade ameaçadora.
Red flags: soar caloroso/paternal; resolver a ambiguidade (a fala deve permanecer dúbia).
Registro: erudito cômico, pomposo e arcaico; bajulador do Ukon; alívio cômico.
Características: fala arcaica/empolada (equivalente a "vós/peço-vos/meus olhos não me enganam") + gag de cicio (s→sh, ex.: "SHEEKETH"/"shir"); melodramático; gruda no Haku como "benfeitor".
Red flags: perder o arcaísmo ou o cicio (são a piada); soar moderno/neutro; explicar a comédia. Manter o contraste entre a pompa do vocabulário e a fragilidade do personagem.

Oshtor — `voice_criticality: high`. = Ukon até 13_08 (ver spoiler_ledger). Registro formal, nobre, comedido; General da Direita. Antes do reveal, traduzir como o mercenário "Ukon" (espirituoso, informal) — NÃO antecipar a pompa de general
Características: frases quebradas por reticências; perguntas curtas ("Quem... é você...?"); pouca pontuação forte.
Red flags: falas fluentes/articuladas demais; perder o tom de torpor; pontuação "limpa" que apaga a fragmentação.
Registro: guerreiro carismático, espirituoso, caloroso e informal; líder nato que trata Haku como um irmão mais novo.
Características: desembaraçado, brincalhão, generoso; fala direta e cativante; autoridade leve (lidera a Coorte) sem arrogância.
Red flags: soar rígido/formal/militar demais (a graça é justamente o contraste com a patente); frieza. SPOILER: não deixar a tradução insinuar a identidade verdadeira — no cap.12 ele é só "Ukon".

decisions.title: Opcode de RÓTULO DE FALANTE `53 00` + reconcile de speaker (data-driven)
decisions.summary: **Problema:** in-game, o rótulo de falante aparecia em **inglês** ("Girl") mesmo com a tradução ("Garota") aprovada e gravada. RE: o nome do falante usa um **2º opcode de ponteiro, `53 00`** (mesmo formato file-relativo do `50 00` de diálogo), que o conector ignorava. Resultado: "Girl"→"Garota"

decisions.title: Gate de charset pt-BR — método e veredito
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: likely` e exigir confirmação in-game antes de produção. **Alternativas consideradas:** - Confirmar por presença no texto-fonte — **insuficiente**: o fonte é inglês e quase não usa acentos (só `õ` e `À` aparecem em texto real).

decisions.title: Anomalia 0x33f9 — texto PT/EN corrompido na fonte
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar a linha `0x33f9` como anomalia de fonte (não traduzir em cima do lixo; tratar como linha de sistema reescrita). **Razão:** A string original já vem misturada PT/EN e truncada ("...SISTEMAS AM . RESTARTING...") no próprio jogo. Não é erro de extração. O conector deve sinali

decisions.title: Charset — transliteração na gravação (gate FALHOU)
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: false` e **transliterar** (acento → ASCII) na gravação do binário. A tradução canônica (`approved_translations.csv`, `translation_plan.json`) **mantém os acentos** (correta para QA/revisão); apenas os bytes escritos no jogo são dobrados para ASCI

lines.source: GYAAAAH!
Huff, hah, hah...
W-We won...
What prowess. I had no idea men like him existed\n
in Tuskur.
Kuon...
Right...\n
He was someone she knew, huh?
It's not over yet! Nobody let your guard down.
What?
This man... The Kurou I know wouldn't go down\n
so easily.
Huh... But he's...?
We did quite a number on him. He may be\n
breathing, but he's not in fighting shape.
He's likely toying with us.
Chances are, he's waiting for us to be convinced\n
of our victory so he can have the last laugh.
I highly doubt he's any danger to us in the\n
state he's in.
She's right. I've never had anyone take a blow\n
from me and be quite all right afterwards.
Cocopo?
Come on, now. Why would you go and ruin the\n
surprise like that?
Wh--
This guy's good.
That can't be... We just...
How? I was sure we hit all sorts of vital spots...
That really stings, you know. I thought I was\n
really in danger for a moment, there.
Hee hee. Just an act, then? I see.
No, no, really. That beating you gave me?\n
Knocked the drowsiness RIGHT out of me.
Ooh, what a man... You might go and actually\n
make me get serious!
But is that really what you expect of me,\n
my lady? That I'd just try to get a laugh out\n
of you?
Could it be you're still nursing grudges from\n
years ago?
I mean, sure, I pinched your snacks from time\n
to time, but it was a spur-of-the-moment thing.
...So you were the culprit.
Huh? Heh, didn't expect you to remember that.\n
Guess I walked right into that one.
Easy, now. I wouldn't do that, if I were you.\n
If you don't retreat soon, it'll be too late\n
for you.
Too late?
Some other force is acting as a distraction\n
while you make off with the supplies, right?
The longer you take, the more danger you're\n
putting your comrades in. I know I'm right.
I appreciate your concern, but the one leading\n
that force isn't as weak as you think.
Oh? That so?
If I were you, I wouldn't talk such a big game.
Nngh! I knew it--
That's right. How long will your "distraction"\n
last against the Chief, I wonder...?
I shall open the "gate." All forces, defensive\n
bulkhead formation! Now!
Soldier
No, you mustn't! Releasing your full power\n
will tax you too much, Lady Munechika--!!
It's likely that these soldiers are their\n
elite.
It is our duty to hold their attention for as\n
long as we can.
Lord Haku and the others are trusting in us so\n
their plan can succeed. We shall not fail them.
I am sorry, but... I must ask you all to entrust\n
your lives to me.
...Lady Munechika.
Speak no more. We will follow you to the bitter\n
end!
...You have my apologies and my greatest thanks.
I am the Guardian! Open the way to the origin,\n
O Akuruka, and through it grant me the heavens'\n
aegis!
With a flash of blinding light, Munechika's\n
power manifests before her as a great,\n
shielding barrier.
All soldiers, ready weapons!
...Forward.
Benawi and his rakusharai charge forward,\n
unflappable in the face of Munechika's display\n
of power.
You shall go no further!
The earth before Munechika rolls and undulates\n
in a great wave, as if to swallow Benawi's\n
forces...
Yes!
But Benawi and his soldiers gracefully sidestep\n
it, charging instead from Munechika's flank.
Hah!!
As Benawi's soldiers close in from the sides,\n
they release a hail of arrows, pinning the\n
Yamatans down.
What!?
The tables turn quickly as arrows rain down on\n
Munechika's forces...
Tch. Ring formation!
Munechika quickly rallies her troops and\n
protects them from the archers, but Benawi\n
surrounds her.
They're fast--
Benawi's rakusharai circle like a pack of\n
predators seeking an opening in the herd, then\n
charge.
Gah!
The Yamatan line buckles under the pressure\n
from Benawi, and soon, Munechika's position\n
is threatened.
Nngh...
With nothing between her and Benawi, Munechika\n
quickly takes a gash from his spear and cries\n
out.
Rgh... If I use my abilities in such close\n
quarters, I can't avoid hitting my own soldiers--
Munechika manages to block each of Benawi's\n
attacks, but the ferocity of them slowly drives\n
her back.
This man... He's well-versed in how to fight\n
people with abilities like mine.
Munechika grits her teeth, keeping up her\n
defense, the clash of steel continuing\n
relentlessly.
I see now. This is what Lady Kuon had meant.
She was not worried for her countrymen's\n
safety... but my own.
I've grown sloppy. Haphazard. When did I become\n
so overconfident in my own skills...?
Suddenly, Benawi lowers his spear, and the\n
menacing aura about him dissipates almost\n
instantly.
His rakusharai also cease their fighting,\n
instead lining up behind their commander.
What...?
I believe that will be enough, Lady Munechika.
Wh--You know my name?
I am Benawi, and mine is the mantle of\n
Warmaster of Tuskur.
So it IS you. I am General Munechika, of the\n
Eight Pillars of Yamato.
You'd do best to fall back now, Pillar.\n
Your plan has already ended in failure.
Fall back...? You're not demanding surrender?
Yes. Forcing a surrender from you would be a...\n
costly pursuit.
And besides...
Besides?
You no longer have a reason to fight.
Regardless of the outcome here, you will return\n
to your country and begone.
What are y--
Well, I'm warmed up, now. Why don't we have\n
another bout, hm?
Jachdwalt, on me.
Understood!
HYAH!
Gah! That was close...\n
Huh?
You were talking about letting us go, so I think\n
we'll be taking you up on that offer.
Oh...? Turning tail when you realize the wind's\n
not in your favor? Quick tactical thinking.
What's your name, boy?
It's Haku.
Haku? But that's...
Jachdwalt.
Yessir. Last one, yeah?
What the--\n
Oh, you HAVE to be kidding me.
We'll gladly accept these gifts, as well.\n
Later, old man!
Heh... Ah heh heh.
Ahahaha! What in the world? The nerve on that\n
kid... He's good.
No one would've expected an idiotic plan like\n
that to go off without a hitch. No one sane.
And his name's Haku. What exactly is that\n
supposed to mean... my lady?
Kurou, status report.
...They got me. Got me good, too.\n
Sorry about that, chief.
It won't be an issue. As I said, they'll have\n
no choice but to pull out, regardless of the\n
outcome.
I never expected them to execute on a plan like\n
that, though.
Bold, almost insane tactics...\n
Remind you of anyone we know?
You seem happy about it.
I'm not the only one here smiling, chief.
My lady was with him, too. She seems to be\n
doing well. Good to see her.
I see. She accompanied them all the way here...
Kurou, with me. We shall give chase.
Yes, sir.
